correctness.rationale: For fixed b>0 the Jacobian polynomial is (lambda+b)(lambda²-a lambda+1), so eigenvalue pair crosses at a=0 with derivative 1/2 and third eigenvalue -b. Independently formed right q=(1,i,0), adjoint p=(1/2,i/2,1/[2(b-i)]), quadratic tensor B(u,v)=(0,0,2u_x v_x); symbolic resolvent substitution gives G21=-4i/[3(b+i)(b+2i)] and Re G21=-4b/[(b²+1)(b²+4)]. Therefore l1=-2b/[(b²+1)(b²+4)]<0. A separate quadratic center manifold z=[(b²+2)x²-2bxy+2y²]/[b(b²+4)]+O(||(x,y)||³) solves the invariance identity exactly. Classical Hopf theory yields unique orbitally stable local cycle for small a>0 with physical radius sqrt([(b²+1)(b²+4)/b]a)+O_b(a). At a=0, radial normal form drho/dt=-c_b rho³+O(rho^4) and local exponential stable foliation give t(x²+y²)->(b²+1)(b²+4)/b except for one-dimensional strong-stable manifold, where decay exponential. Distinguish standard normal-form theorem from finite symbolic check; no global flow claim.
